g.text: Multi-Tier Architecture Diagram (React 18 SPA • Express & Node.js • PostgreSQL 16 • Local Media Storage)
APPLICATION TIER — Express & Node.js REST API Server
JWT Token Auth: Issues HS256 signed bearer tokens with 1h/2h TTL
Parameterized SQL: Protection against SQL Injection using $1, $2 bindings
Models Structure: models/user.js, posts.js, friend.js, messages.js, comments.js
Connection Pool: pg.Pool manages reusable client connections to PostgreSQL
Centralized Error Handling & async/await controller pattern
DATA & PERSISTENCE TIER — Relational Database & Media Storage
